message:
feat(keepalive-r2 ②, b/e): the device id + last generation in one small file, replaced whole

FileGenerationStore: 20 bytes (16-byte device id, 32-bit last generation) written to <path>.tmp and moved over the old
one (POSIX rename; on Windows MoveFileEx REPLACE_EXISTING -- std::rename does not replace there); a short / long /
unreadable file is nothing usable (a new device id). For the APK's files dir (native_bridge) and a PC client.
Test: standby_entry_client_test file cases under REMOTE60_TEST_TMP only (its own two files, removed): 56/56; skipped
without the variable (51/51). Mutant std::rename on Windows -> 4 FAIL.
